source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Working Together Online (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Online mil kar kaam karna teams ko ek jagah hue baghair khayalat share karne, feedback (raye) dene lene aur kaam mukammal karne deta hai. Documents, discussions aur wasail tak mushtarka rasai se yeh cooperation (taawun) aur creativity barhata hai. Talaba samajhte hain ke wazeh communication aur ek doosre ki izzat kamyab online teamwork ki kunji hain. Digital collaboration seekhna unhein jadeed workplaces ke liye tayyar karta hai jahan remote work (door se kaam) aam hai. Online teamwork masle hal karne ki himmat afzai karta hai aur zaroori interpersonal skills (logon se milne julne ki salahiyat) banata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jo teams wazeh baat-cheet karti hain woh kaam jaldi aur kam ghaltiyon ke saath mukammal karti hain.

blocks.prompt: Online teamwork ki kamyabi ki do chabiyan (keys) kaun si hain aur yeh mustaqbil mein kyun kaam aati hai?
blocks.explanation: Wazeh communication aur aik doosre ki izzat (mutual respect). Jadeed workplaces mein remote work aam hai, is liye online collaboration seekhna aage kaam aata hai.

items: Online kaam: ideas share, feedback, tasks; aik jagah hona zaroori nahi.
Problem solving aur interpersonal skills (logon ke saath kaam ki salahiyat) barhti hain.
